item.title: Student Art & Ceramics Sale — Fri Nov 20, 4:00 PM
item.description:
The Student Art & Ceramics Sale returns to the S. Tucker Cooke Gallery in Owen Hall on Friday, November 20, from 4–8 p.m., and Saturday, November 21, from 9 a.m.–3 p.m. Visitors can shop an array of student-made ceramics, prints, and artwork—perfect for holiday gifts! If you have any questions about access or would like to request reasonable accommodations that will facilitate your full participation in the film screenings, please contact Stephanie Bullick, Director of Accessibility, at accessibility@unca.edu. item.title: Sun Circle: Sagittarius Season — Sun Nov 22, 6:30 PM
item.description:
Awakening Asheville When the sun moves into a new sign an energetic shift occurs. Learning to connect, listen, and set intentions with the sun is a beautiful way to add ritual into your life.
Sagittarius season is from 11/22 - 12/20 and for this gathering we'll discuss the Astrological happenings of the zodiac season and where it will impact you personally (birth chart recommended not required).
As with all energetic shifts, getting into your body is important. Together we'll ground into the energy through meditation and somatic movement themed around the season. Accommodations/Modification will be made for ALL bodies, come as you are. We'll close out with time for journaling and optional sharing.
***Bring:*** Comfortable clothes to move in Journal and pen Birth chart if you have it water bottle
***Cash \|\| Venmo \|\| Card are all accepted at the door also***
Source: Awakening Asheville, Senseful Soul's Asheville Healing Community

item.description:
The Unitarian Universalist Congregation of Asheville (UUAVL) and the Unitarian Universalist Congregation of the Swannanoa Valley (UUSV) are teaming up for this year’s Thanksgiving Potluck Luncheon. Please sign up in Sandburg Hall after services to bring a covered dish and to volunteer for setup, takedown, or one of the two kitchen crews. item.title: 9:15 Contemplative Service — Sun Nov 29, 9:15 AM — *1 Sanctuary
item.description:
At 9:15 AM, we have a 40-45 minute Contemplative Worship Service. This service invites participants into a reflective, more meditative space, and includes silence, beautiful recorded music and videos, and opportunities for sharing. It also features the sermon and theme which will be the focus in the second service at 11:15 AM. This service is not livestreamed., and it include childcare but not a full religious education program. This service will be particularly good if you need quiet in order to hear well or focus, would prefer a little more space around you, or seek a more contemplative communal experience. Between services, at 10 am we will have coffee hour and special programs. Whether you come to the early service or the later service, we encourage you to consider arriving at 10 am for coffee, conversation, and special programs including conversations with the Board, or Minister & lay-led justice or adult education offerings.
Source: Unitarian Universalist Congregation of Ashevi

item.title: Alcohol Through the Lens of Motherhood — Mon Nov 30, 2:00 PM
item.description:
Asheville Community Mom's Group **RSVPing on Meetup doesn’t reserve your spot for this session!**
To join, please sign up through our site here: https://www.totem.org/spaces/session/sfi204exc/
All sessions are free, and signing up on the site helps us create a smoother experience for everyone. Feel free to message me with any questions or concerns!
\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-
For many of us, alcohol has played a role in some pretty meaningful memories. Holidays, celebrations, nights out with friends, or even a drink at the end of a long day. For others, it brings up memories we'd rather forget. And as we get older, especially once we become parents, our relationships with alcohol can change in ways we didn't expect.
With the holidays approaching, we're exploring how alcohol fits into our lives and families. From our own drinking habits to navigating how others drink around our children, we'll talk about the traditions, boundaries, and conversations

item.title: Fun & easy way to play more tennis (please read event description for details) — Tue Dec 8, 7:00 PM
item.description:
PlayYourCourt Asheville Tennis We’re still working to get more people into these Meetups, but our goal is to give PlayYourCourt members a few social tennis outings each week in addition to your practice sessions and Challenge League matches.
These Meetups are co-ed, super laid back, and all skill levels are welcome. Post your skill level and a suggested court in the comments section so we can round up as many players as we can for some tennis fun!
Also, if you’re looking to meet new practice partners or play some matches and you aren’t already in the PlayYourCourt Community, you can go here to see what we’re all about and sign up:
https://www.playyourcourt.com/tennis-community/asheville-nc/meetup/
If you love tennis, we’d love to have you! Be sure and watch the quick video that explains how everything works.

item.title: Hello My Dear — Fri Jan 8, 8:30 PM
item.description: Hello My Dear is the acoustic duo of Caitlin Krisko and Aaron Austin (of Caitlin Krisko & the Broadcast), delivering soulful, roots-driven originals and covers steeped in blues, Americana, and classic rock. Hello My Dear offers a warm, high-impact performance that feel both powerful and deeply personal. Rooted in the songs and spirit that have defined their journey together the duo presents a more stripped-down, emotionally resonant expression of the music of Caitlin Krisko & The Broadcast, alongside carefully curated covers that have shaped their sound. At the heart of Hello My Dear is Caitlin Krisko's unmistakeable voice, equal parts raw power and ender storytelling, paired with Aaron Austin's soulful, dynamic guitar work. Described by Rolling Stones as "one of the best-kept vocal secrets of the southeast," Krisko brings the same vocal gravity and emotional honesty that has earned widespread acclaim in the band's full electric setting, translated beautifully into an acoustic format.
